Troubleshooting · 04/50 · rights

Usage rights expire before campaign end

Failure signal

A usage rights expire before campaign end condition is reported or detected during rights.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for rights does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Compare territory, media and end dates in releases with the media plan.

Corrective action

Restrict the plan or obtain a documented extension before distribution.

Prevention

Add this verification to the rights gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
